title: upgrade_ outcome (outcome.json)
description: Written by `upgrade_` (the converter) at the end of the cutover - or at whatever point it stopped - and read by `settle-in`. It is the record of what actually happened, including which side of the commit line the machine is on. Written to the stick only; it leaves the stick only if the person chooses to submit it. A reader that meets a `schema` value it does not know must refuse, not guess.

job_id.description: Must equal the job.json this outcome executed. settle-in refuses a pair that does not match.

status.description: completed: the cutover finished and the machine is about to reboot into Linux. stopped: a refusal or the person's fork said stop; nothing destructive happened. failed: something broke - `stopped_at` and `reason` say where, `commit_line.crossed` says how bad.

stopped_at.description: The stage that stopped or failed. Null when completed.

path_taken.description: The path the fork actually resolved to. Null when the run stopped before the fork.

commit_line.description: Exactly one irreversible moment per conversion. On keep-windows it is the reclaim in settle-in, so a converter-written outcome on that path always says crossed=false. On clean-slate it is the wipe.

prologue.description: The Windows-side, reversible half. Every step records what it did so a stopped run can be read back.

revalidated.description: job.json matched the live machine (identity triple, stick identity, BitLocker state, volume flag state).

volume_check.description: RISKS R18 step 1b. `evaluate` never repairs; this is the only place a disk check runs, with its four guardrails, and its real outcome is recorded here.

needed.description: The online scan confirmed the flag before anything ran.

scan.description: What `Repair-Volume -Scan` (read-only) answered, verbatim - the guardrail that chooses spot-fix over the full check. Null when no scan ran.

restarts.description: Restarts the check took (spot-fix once; a second one only if the flag survived and the rescan logged errors).

disk_health_at_check.description: `Get-PhysicalDisk` HealthStatus read immediately before the repair. Anything but Healthy is a refusal (`ran` false, status stopped).

method.description: spot-fix: Repair-Volume -SpotFix (offline for seconds, fixes only what the scan logged). chkdsk-f: the full check, only when the scan logged real errors.

wininit_1001.description: The text of the Wininit event 1001 the check left behind, verbatim.

found000_present.description: Whether the check left a found.000 folder - orphaned fragments the person should be told about.

remeasured_gb.description: Shrinkable space measured by the prologue at the moment it mattered - the number the fork branched on. Null if never measured.

remeasured_by.description: Which read-only path produced remeasured_gb: the Storage API (Get-PartitionSupportedSize) or diskpart's shrink querymax (VDS). Both are tried; the second number is kept beside it.

remeasured_diskpart_gb.description: diskpart's independent figure, when it answered. Disagreement with the Storage API is a finding (VALIDATION V4).

freed_bytes.description: What Resize-Partition actually freed. 0 on clean-slate or a stop.

staged.description: clean-slate only: the person's files copied to the stick with per-file checksums, at a measured write speed the time estimate was computed from.

marker.description: The marker file the prologue put beside the kickstart on the stick, which grub.cfg branches on: boot-install for the conversion.

cutover.description: The live-environment half. Absent when the run stopped in the prologue.

stick_verified.description: Every staged checksum read back from the stick (also the counterfeit-flash test, RISKS R17).

hardware.description: Automated checks before anything is destroyed; the human two-minute gate (clean-slate) is recorded as `human_gate`.

esp_snapshot.description: keep-windows: EFI/Boot and EFI/Microsoft (every file, with checksums) and the firmware Boot#### entries, copied to the stick before the ESP is touched. What rollback restores from.

boot_chain.description: The checklist decided 2026-08-30 (RISKS R21). None of these aborts - a failed item is written down for settle-in to show.

fallback_loader.description: What sits at EFI/Boot/bootx64.efi after the install. shim is kept on purpose while Windows is kept; the snapshot holds Windows' copy.

restore.description: clean-slate: the person's files put back from the stick.

windows.description: Where Windows is now. settle-in needs the partition to mount it on the keep-windows path, and the reachability to tell the person how to roll back.

credentials.description: RISKS R13. The recovery key is needed by settle-in's pull, so on keep-windows it is scrubbed after the pull, not here.

allOf.description: keep-windows never crosses the commit line in the converter; Windows is kept and the snapshot exists.
clean-slate: a completed run crossed the line at the wipe and Windows is gone.
A stopped run never crossed the line.
